request.style: English, male baritone solo with gentle choir support, acoustic guitar, cello, flute, soft percussion, somber and reflective mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior
But the son of a prostitute in that land
His brothers drove him out of the father's house
Saying you are the son of another woman

[Verse]
He fled to the land of Tob among outcasts
Where worthless men gathered around him
When Ammon made war upon Israel
The elders of Gilead sought him out

[Verse]
They said come be our commander in battle
And Jephthah asked why now in trouble
If the Lord gives the enemy into my hand
Then I shall be your head in Gilead

[Verse]
He sent messengers to the king of Ammon
Arguing for the land of Israel
But the king paid no heed to the message
So Jephthah made a vow to the Lord

[Verse]
If you give the Ammonites into my hand
Whoever comes out shall belong to God
He struck down twenty towns in the valley
A crushing blow that subdued the enemy

[Verse]
When he came home to Mizpah in triumph
His daughter met him with tambourines and dance
She was his only child in this world
And he tore his clothes in deep sorrow

[Verse]
Oh my daughter you have brought me to my knees
I have opened my mouth to the Lord
She said do to me as you have vowed
Grant me two months to weep on the hills

[Outro]
And so it became a custom in Israel
